status: Private proposal controls and help copy; game implementation and handoff are not authorised.
scope: Flight controls. Every help screen includes this same clearly labelled Flight controls block. Menu and mission-dialog confirmation remains a separate context; Return in a menu confirms its focused choice and never fires a weapon.

screens.title: Flight
screens.heading: Flight controls

bindings.detail: Cycle equipped Main Laser, Mining Laser, Salvage Cutter and EMP Blaster. Update the persistent weapon indicator immediately; retain the current hold.

Hold Return to operate the selected weapon: fire the Main Laser, mine with the Mining Laser, cut with the Salvage Cutter, or charge/fire EMP. Release to stop the held action. Require a fresh press after a weapon change, readiness transition or interruption. Releasing Return retains the hold.
Activate fitted ECM directly, subject to actual energy and cooldown requirements. ECM stays separate from weapon selection.
End automatic hold/guidance and stop the active tool. Return control to the player while preserving momentum.

screens.footer: W: CHANGE WEAPON | RETURN: FIRE | E: ECM | Q: RELEASE HOLD
screens.detail: Read the persistent WEAPON indicator before firing. W and Return never release an established hold.

screens.footer: W: CHANGE WEAPON | RETURN: FIRE | E: ECM | Q: RELEASE HOLD
screens.detail: Asteroid targeting establishes a safe target-relative hold and selects the fitted Mining Laser. W can select Main Laser instead; held Return then breaks the rock into much smaller chunks, leaving strictly less than 5% of its original mass recoverable. Most rock disintegrates permanently. Collect surviving chunks with fitted scoops; changing weapon or firing does not release the hold before the parent breaks apart.
